jd_requirements: MS + 4 years commercial robotics experience or PhD

selected_projects.project: L.I.F.T: A Hybrid Flying and Driving Robot Platform

bullets.text: Led a 5-member cross-functional team to develop a hybrid flying-driving robot platform, delivering a fully functional prototype within 10 weeks.
Developed a ROS2-based robotic system integrating a simulator and MPC controller, enabling precise obstacle avoidance and full trajectory completion with real-time state logging.
Integrated OptiTrack motion capture system with the robotic platform, achieving <1 mm position accuracy and <10 ms latency, supporting real-time closed-loop control in indoor environments.
Designed and implemented a unified drivetrain supporting both aerial and ground locomotion using the same motor-gear system, reducing mechanical complexity and cost.
Led mechanical design of 3 robots for a national robotics competition with 80 teams: two autonomous systems for ring retrieval and launch, and a joystick-controlled quadruped for speed racing.

edits.reason: Removed internal nicknames for professionalism; preserved all factual claims

bullets.text: Developed embedded C firmware for STM32F407, enabling CAN-based motor control, BLE remote communication, and PID position control with +/-2 mm tracking error for an omnidirectional mobile robot.
Designed a modular PID-based navigation system on STM32 with inverse kinematics and yaw compensation, achieving omnidirectional motion and +/-0.1% global localization accuracy.
Implemented a custom UART protocol with headers, footers, and float unpacking; leveraged DMA + interrupts for non-blocking 100Hz updates of 6-DoF data, with <0.2% error rate.

edits.reason: Replaced banned mid-sentence verb 'used' with stronger verb

selected_projects.project: Wuhan Xiaoxian AI Technology Co., Ltd.

bullets.text: Proposed and implemented a magnetically-triggered encoder-based imaging system to replace low-precision pulse triggering, achieving +/-1mm positional accuracy and reducing point-cloud data loss by 30%.
Developed control programs for a six-axis CRP2 robotic arm using embedded C and ladder logic, enabling automated multi-axis motion planning for fuel rod testing.
Designed an STM32F103-based gateway to enable Modbus RTU communication between the PC and robotic controller, ensuring stable real-time data exchange for sensor and actuator coordination.

bullets.text: Designed a compact ESP32-based crane system with Wi-Fi remote control, enabling low-latency communication and autonomous coordination across multiple devices, achieving over 95% task repeatability.
Independently developed an STM32-based closed-loop control system using fuzzy PID algorithms for stepper motor control, achieving +/-1 mm positioning accuracy.

Designed a multi-servo gripper system with ultrasonic radar for 360-degree object detection, capable of grasping up to 3 objects simultaneously.
